text:
jordan: Heads-up: We're deploying inference-service v3.4.2 to prod tonight at 23:00 UTC. Rolling across 2 AZs. Posting rollback-readiness checklist — please ack and call out blockers.

neha: Ack. Quick Q — canary will be 10% for 15m, right? How do we run the smoke suite for canary?

sam: Yes, canary 10% for 15m per the rollout config. Smoke job is smoke/inference_smoke.yaml — run in staging then against canary. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/deploys/v3.4.2

ops_lead: I'll own monitoring for the window. On-call: @sre-oncall and @neha. If errors spike >2% for 5m we rollback. Rolling criteria below.

sre-bot: Preflight checks: infra health OK, CI passed (unit/integration), canary image built. artifact sha=abc123def. CPU headroom across pools: 18%.

ui-qa: I'll run UI smoke after canary stabilization. Tests: login, chat generation, embeddings. ETA ~23:10 UTC.

jordan: Rollback command (manual):
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-service --to-revision=42
```
Also toggle feature flag 'v3_4_2' off: `/ff toggle v3_4_2 false`

sam: Rollback criteria (agreed): 1) error rate >2% sustained for 5m, 2) P99 latency increases >1s vs baseline, 3) any data-corruption or request-loss reports, 4) model-quality regressions >5% on evals. If any met -> rollback + page.

ops_lead: I'll own the runbook trigger. If criteria hit I run 'rollback-immediate'. Who executes the undo? @sam?

sam: I'll execute the undo and coordinate with infra to drain connections and resume traffic routing. @jordan please confirm release notes flagged and comms to customers if needed.

neha: One action: add KV cache warm-up in post-deploy. Without warm-up first requests spike latency. I added script `/deploy/scripts/warm_kv.sh`. Make it part of post-deploy hook.

jordan: :thumbsup: Acks from neha, sam, ops_lead, ui-qa, sre-bot. Final preflight check at 22:30 UTC for go/no-go.

sre-bot: Reminder: deploy window starts 2026-03-17T23:00Z. Canary metrics dashboard: https://telemetry/redwood/canary/abc123

ops_lead: I'll be on standby 22:45-00:30 UTC. Paging rules and escalation path set.

ui-qa: If all green, I'll post final smoke report here by 23:20.

neha: Small preshift: disable background cache evictions during rollout — set ENV `CACHE_EVICT=false` in canary pods so warm-up isn't undone.

jordan: Final call: go/no-go at 22:45 UTC. If no objections we'll proceed as planned.
